evidence.locator: Data Preparation; Data Layout; Evaluation pipeline
evidence.statement: The official release provides collision sequences and a reconstruction/evaluation pipeline for generated rollouts, including temporal dynamics, momentum and kinetic-energy diagnostics. Admission concerns the specified world-model evaluation protocol, not visual collision classification.
